title: Teardrop-shaped transmedium UAP video shown in a joint task force SCIF
place_text: Over the ocean; joint task force overseas

tellings.quote: observing this teardropshaped looking UAP that might have been 20 ft lengthwise or so and it was traveling under the ocean water

plain: A naval intelligence commander is said to have sent an email with a video of a teardrop-shaped UAP (an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, the government's term for a UFO), maybe 20 feet long, "traveling under the ocean water". The video was then shown in a SCIF, a sealed room for viewing classified material, at a joint task force overseas. The retired Navy admiral Tim Gallaudet tells Michels this second-hand. If true, the military has footage of an unknown object that can move both through the air and underwater.
